title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantees for the Establishment of the Science and Technology Innovation Board and the Pilot Registration-Based IPO System Reform
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantees for the Establishment of the Sci-Tech Innovation Board (STAR Market) and the Pilot Reform of the Registration-Based IPO System"

Fa Fa [2019] No. 17

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The "Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Guarantees for the Establishment of the Sci-Tech Innovation Board (STAR Market) and the Pilot Reform of the Registration-Based IPO System" are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation.

June 20, 2019

Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantees for the Establishment of the Sci-Tech Innovation Board (STAR Market) and the Pilot Reform of the Registration-Based IPO System

The establishment of the Sci-Tech Innovation Board (STAR Market) on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (hereinafter referred to as the SSE) and the pilot reform of the registration-based IPO system constitute a crucial measure taken by the central authorities to implement the innovation-driven development strategy and promote high-quality development, and are an important arrangement for deepening the reform of the capital market. In order to fully leverage the adjudicative functions of people's courts, jointly promote the coordinated advancement of reforms in the basic systems of the capital market, such as issuance, listing, information disclosure, trading, and delisting, maintain an open, fair, and just capital market order, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of investors, the following opinions are hereby put forward regarding the proper adjudication by people's courts of cases related to the STAR Market during the pilot period of the registration-based IPO system.

I. Enhance Understanding and Strengthen the Consciousness and Initiative to Provide Judicial Guarantees for the Establishment of the STAR Market and the Pilot Reform of the Registration-Based IPO System

1. Fully recognize the significance of establishing the STAR Market and piloting the registration-based IPO system. General Secretary Xi Jinping announced at the opening ceremony of the first China International Import Expo the establishment of the STAR Market on the SSE and the pilot of the registration-based IPO system, fully reflecting the high regard and earnest expectations of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core for the reform and development of the capital market. The Central Economic Work Conference proposed that the capital market plays a pivotal role in financial operations, and that through deepening reforms, a standardized, transparent, open, vibrant, and resilient capital market should be built. Starting with the establishment of the STAR Market and steadily piloting the registration-based IPO system for stock issuance is not only an important manifestation of deepening supply-side structural reform in the financial sector and perfecting the basic system of the capital market, but also conducive to better leveraging the capital market's function of supporting the enhancement of key technology innovation and the competitiveness of the real economy, and better serving high-quality development. People's courts at all levels must adhere to Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, earnestly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's series of important instructions and directives on the capital market, properly handle new situations and new problems in disputes related to the STAR Market, regard the protection of investors' legitimate rights and interests and the prevention and resolution of financial risks as the fundamental tasks of securities adjudication, and create a favorable judicial environment for accelerating the formation of a multi-tiered capital market system with complete financing functions, sound basic systems, effective market supervision, and effective protection of investors' legitimate rights and interests.

2. Accurately grasp the positioning of the STAR Market and the arrangements of the registration-based IPO pilot. The STAR Market is an incremental reform of the capital market and a "testing ground" for the reform and innovation of the basic systems of the capital market. The STAR Market mainly serves scientific and technological innovation enterprises that conform to national strategies, have broken through key core technologies, and have a high degree of market recognition. The conditions for issuance and listing are more inclusive, not requiring enterprises to be profitable before listing, allowing enterprises with "shares with different voting rights" and red-chip enterprises that meet the provisions of the innovation pilot to list, and implementing more market-oriented systems for issuance and underwriting, trading, mergers and acquisitions and restructuring, and delisting. Pursuant to the authorization of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, during the reform process of the registration-based IPO system, the relevant provisions of the Securities Law of the People's Republic of China regarding the approval system for public issuance of stocks shall be adjusted and applied. The current pilot of the registration-based IPO system is generally divided into two stages: SSE review and CSRC registration. The CSRC supervises the review work of the SSE, establishing and improving a stock issuance and listing system centered on information disclosure. People's courts at all levels must adhere to the general tone of seeking progress while maintaining stability, base themselves on the actual situation of securities criminal, civil, and administrative adjudication, identify the entry points, further implement the central reform deployments and policy requirements through adjudication in accordance with law, and promote the formation of a good market ecology in which all market participants perform their duties in accordance with law, fulfill their responsibilities, and effectively protect their legitimate rights and interests, providing strong judicial guarantees for investors to invest with confidence and for Sci-Tech innovation companies to innovate boldly.

II. Respect the Laws of Capital Market Development, and Ensure the Smooth Advancement of the Reform of the Stock Issuance System Dominated by Market Mechanisms in Accordance with Law

3. Support the stock exchange in prudently conducting stock issuance and listing review. According to the reform arrangements, the SSE mainly conducts review work by raising review inquiries to the issuer and having the issuer respond to the questions. In the trial of cases, if the information disclosed by the issuer, its sponsors, and securities service institutions in the issuance and listing application documents and in the process of answering questions contains false records, misleading statements, or material omissions, they shall be ordered to bear legal liability for false statements; if the false statements constitute fraud to obtain issuance and listing review and registration, they shall be ordered to bear legal liability for fraudulent issuance. To ensure the smooth progress of the issuance system reform, the first-instance civil and commercial cases such as securities issuance disputes, securities underwriting contract disputes, securities listing sponsorship contract disputes, securities listing contract disputes, and securities fraud liability disputes involving enterprises that initially publicly issue stocks and list on the STAR Market shall be subject to the centralized jurisdiction of the Shanghai Financial Court on a pilot basis.

4. Ensure that the stock exchange implements self-regulatory supervision in accordance with law. Due to the inclusive nature of the STAR Market's listing thresholds and the characteristics of Sci-Tech innovation companies, such as rapid technological iteration and long profit cycles, there is an objective need to strengthen supervision during and after the event. For the business rules of the STAR Market formulated by the stock exchange through statutory procedures regarding issuance, listing, and ongoing supervision, as long as they do not violate mandatory provisions of laws and regulations, people's courts may refer to and apply them in accordance with law when trying cases. To unify adjudication standards, according to Article 3 of the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction of Cases by the Shanghai Financial Court" (Fa Shi [2018] No. 14), first-instance financial civil and commercial cases and administrative cases related to the performance of duties with the SSE as the defendant or a third party shall still be under the jurisdiction of the Shanghai Financial Court.

5. Ensure that the civil liability system for stock issuance centered on information disclosure is implemented. The pursuit of civil liability is an important part of urging information disclosure obligors to fulfill their duties and responsibilities, and is also the key to whether the law has "teeth." In securities commercial adjudication, in accordance with the requirements of this reform, the responsibilities of the issuer and its related persons shall be strictly implemented. If the controlling shareholder or actual controller of the issuer directs the issuer to engage in fraudulent issuance or false statements, the controlling shareholder or actual controller shall be ordered in accordance with law to directly bear civil compensation liability to investors. The responsibility of securities intermediaries to check and screen for the protection of investors' interests shall be strictly implemented. If a securities service institution fails to perform special duty of care for business matters related to its own profession such as accounting and law, or fails to perform ordinary duty of care for other business matters, it shall be ordered to bear corresponding legal liability. The standard of duty of care for sponsors to comprehensively check and verify the issuer's listing application documents and other information disclosure materials shall be accurately grasped. On the basis of the securities service institution's performance of special duty of care, the sponsor shall still conduct objective and neutral substantive verification of the issuer's operating conditions and risks; otherwise, it cannot meet the evidentiary standard for exemption. For listed companies that fail solely due to business operations without illegal or non-compliant conduct, the principle of "buyer beware" for investment risks under the Securities Law shall be strictly implemented, guiding investors to enhance their risk identification capabilities and rational investment awareness.

6. Respect the establishment of corporate governance structures by STAR Market listed companies that are compatible with the characteristics of scientific and technological innovation. If a STAR Market listed company adopts differentiated voting rights arrangements before listing, people's courts shall, in accordance with the authorization of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for the stock issuance registration-based reform and the provisions of Article 131 of the Company Law, determine the validity of the relevant shareholders' meeting resolutions in accordance with law. If a STAR Market listed company expands the scope of equity incentive recipients to maintain the stability of the entrepreneurial team and key personnel, as long as it does not violate the mandatory provisions of laws and administrative regulations, its validity shall be determined in accordance with law, and the legitimate rights and interests of the incentive recipients shall be protected.

7. Strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property rights for STAR Market listed companies. In accordance with law, hear intellectual property cases involving STAR Market listed companies, such as patent and technology contract disputes. For intellectual property infringement acts involving scientific and technological innovation, increase the amount of compensation to fully reflect the market value of scientific and technological achievements. For malicious infringement acts with serious circumstances, order the infringer to bear punitive damages in accordance with law. Further leverage the judicial supervision function of intellectual property, actively explore the establishment of a validity defense trial system in patent civil infringement lawsuits, promote the substantive resolution of intellectual property administrative disputes, and effectively protect the legitimate intellectual property rights and interests of STAR Market listed companies.

III. Maintain Open, Fair, and Just Market Order, and Increase the Cost of Capital Market Violations in Accordance with Law

8. Severely crack down on securities crimes and financial corruption crimes that interfere with the registration-based reform, and maintain securities market order. In accordance with law, severely punish various types of fraud and corruption crimes that are prone to occur in the application, registration, and other stages. For issuers and intermediaries who collude to defraud issuance registration, and for issuance review and registration staff who abuse power for personal gain, accept bribes, or accept benefit transfers, criminal liability shall be pursued severely in accordance with law. The sponsor's obligation to verify and check the issuer's information shall be emphasized; if the sponsor knows or should know that the issuer fabricates or conceals important information or defrauds issuance registration, criminal liability shall be pursued in accordance with law. In accordance with law, severely punish financial criminals such as those for illegal disclosure or nondisclosure of important information, insider trading, trading on undisclosed information, and market manipulation; strictly control the application of probation; and increase the intensity of economic sanctions such as fines in accordance with law. For enterprises and individuals who maliciously defraud national science and technology support funds or government bailout funds, criminal liability shall be pursued in accordance with law. Strengthen the construction of a criminal information sharing mechanism with securities administrative regulatory authorities. If criminal clues are discovered during the trial of securities cases, they shall be timely reported to the investigation department and relevant materials transferred. Promote the improvement of securities criminal legislation, and timely formulate and issue relevant judicial interpretations to provide legal guarantees for promoting the healthy development of the market.

9. Accept and hear securities fraud liability disputes in accordance with law, and strengthen the civil compensation liability of illegal entities. According to the arrangements of the registration-based pilot, the review of stock issuance and listing has shifted from the regulatory authorities' substantive judgment of the issuer's eligibility conditions to being centered on information disclosure, with investors primarily judging the value of securities themselves. When hearing false statement cases involving STAR Market listed companies, the information disclosure documents to be reviewed include not only routine documents such as prospectuses, annual reports, and interim reports, but also each response to review inquiries and public commitments made by the information disclosure obligor; not only the authenticity, accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and fairness of information disclosure shall be reviewed, but also, taking into account the highly professional and technical nature of STAR Market listed companies, special attention shall be paid to whether the disclosed content is concise and easy to understand, and convenient for ordinary investors to read and comprehend. If senior management and core employees of the issuer participate in the placement through a special asset management plan, people's courts shall presume that they are actually aware of the issuer's false statement, and shall not support the claims for damages filed by the manager or beneficiary of that asset management plan. Strengthen research and guidance on civil compensation cases for insider trading and market manipulation, and actively explore the constituent elements and scope of compensation for civil compensation liability of illegal entities to investors. Increase the intensity of judicial enforcement of administrative penalty cases and civil compensation cases related to the STAR Market, so that illegal entities pay the price for their violations in a timely manner.

10. Hear company dispute cases in accordance with law to enhance investors' confidence in the STAR Market. Actively investigate corporate governance issues such as potential "minority control" and "insider control" that may exist in STAR Market listed companies with special voting rights arrangements. For acts that use corporate autonomy to break through the STAR Market listing rules and infringe upon the legitimate rights of ordinary shareholders, people's courts shall, in accordance with law, deny the validity of the act, prohibit the abuse of rights by special voting rights shareholders, and prevent the alienation of the function of the system. In case trials, accurately define the boundary of rights of special voting rights shareholders, adhere to the principle of "consistency between control and responsibility," and while "shares with different voting rights," also achieve "shares with different responsibilities." Correctly hear cases concerning liability for damages arising from related-party transactions of companies. For responsible entities such as controlling shareholders and actual controllers who harm the company's interests through related-party transactions, even if they have completed the statutory corporate resolution procedures, they shall still bear civil compensation liability; if the related-party transaction contract is void or voidable, and eligible shareholders file claims against the counterparty to the related-party transaction through shareholder representative litigation, such claims shall be supported in accordance with law.

11. In accordance with law, define the civil liability of securities companies for suitability management of investors, and implement the suitability requirements for STAR Market investors. The design of the obligation for suitability management of investors aims to prevent investors from suffering losses by purchasing financial products that do not match their own risk tolerance. The characteristics of Sci-Tech innovation enterprises, such as uncertainty of profitability and stricter delisting conditions, determine that the STAR Market itself has certain risks. The standard of judicial review for whether a securities company has fully performed its duty of suitability management is, at its core, whether the securities company, before providing STAR Market stock brokerage services to investors, has fulfilled its obligation of information disclosure and risk explanation to investors according to objective standards understandable to ordinary persons and subjective standards understandable to the investor. For losses caused to investors due to failure to perform the obligations of suitability review, information disclosure, and risk explanation, people's courts shall order the securities company to bear compensation liability.

12. Hear stock allocation contract disputes in accordance with law, and clarify the civil liability for illegal stock credit transactions. As an important trading method of the securities market and an important business of securities operating institutions, stock credit transactions are, in accordance with law, a financial business subject to state franchise. For stock allocation contracts entered into between investors and corporate entities such as internet allocation platforms and private allocation companies that have not obtained franchise licenses, the contract shall be deemed invalid. For disguised brokerage business carried out by allocation companies or trading software operators using trading software, the contract shall also be deemed invalid.

IV. Effectively Protect the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Investors, and Establish and Improve a Securities Civil Litigation System Compatible with the Registration-Based Reform

13. Promote the improvement of a securities civil litigation system that suits China's national conditions, and reduce the litigation costs of investors. According to the legislative process and reform spirit, fully cooperate with and improve the securities civil litigation system and mechanism that suit China's national conditions. Based on making good and full use of the existing representative litigation system, for joint actions with a large number of plaintiffs, the parties may elect representatives. If the securities investor protection institution established by the securities regulatory authority of the State Council initiates a lawsuit in its own name, or accepts the entrustment of investors to designate staff or entrust litigation agents to participate in case proceedings, the people's court may designate that institution or the party it represents as the representative. Support the lawfully established securities investor protection institution in carrying out securities support litigation work such as providing specialized legal services for investors. Divide the group of eligible plaintiffs according to standards such as common legal issues or common factual issues, and on this basis, promote litigation announcement, rights registration, and representative election in a categorized manner. The representative shall have special authorization from the represented plaintiffs and have litigation rights such as changing or abandoning claims. For settlement or mediation agreements signed between the representative and the defendant, the people's court shall conduct review in accordance with law to protect the legitimate rights and interests of the represented investors. Promote the establishment of a mechanism for investor protection institutions to assist in the enforcement of effective judgments. Drawing on the practice of advance compensation, the court will hand over the execution funds to the investor protection institution for deposit, and then the investor protection institution will make a secondary distribution to the winning investors through the securities trading and settlement system. Actively cooperate with the relevant departments and parties to explore mechanisms for the priority use of administrative fines and criminal fines for civil compensation, and for the connection and coordination of work. Research and explore the establishment of securities civil and administrative public interest litigation systems.

14. Strengthen supporting procedural design to enhance investors' ability to adduce evidence. In securities infringement cases, investors are often in a weak position in obtaining and controlling key evidence. Explore the establishment of a system for lawyers' civil litigation investigation orders to facilitate investors' attorneys in exercising relevant investigation rights and enhance investors' ability to collect evidence on their own. Research and explore appropriately strengthening the assistance obligations of relevant informed units and individuals regarding investors' access to evidence, and impose civil sanctions in accordance with law on units and individuals that refuse to fulfill the obligation to assist in evidence collection.

15. Vigorously carry out innovation in securities adjudication mechanisms, and rely on information technology to enhance judicial capabilities in securities matters. Promote the establishment of an open, dynamic, and transparent expert jury system for securities infringement cases, selecting expert jurors from securities regulatory institutions, securities market operators, research institutions, and other entities to participate in the trial of securities infringement cases. Fully leverage the role of expert witnesses in case trials, and explore the qualifications and management methods for expert witnesses. Research and develop a national court securities adjudication work information platform, realize online paperless filing of securities cases through information technology, facilitate the filing of group litigation, rely on the information platform to improve the unified registration mechanism for group litigation, and solve problems such as rights registration of eligible plaintiffs and election of representatives. Focus on solving the issue of connecting case trials with securities trading data, provide support for the calculation of loss compensation amounts, and improve trial efficiency.

16. Comprehensively promote the diversified resolution of securities and futures disputes, and promote the model judgment mechanism for securities cases. Adhere to putting non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms in the forefront, implement the "Opinions on Comprehensively Promoting the Construction of a Diversified Resolution Mechanism for Securities and Futures Disputes," rely on the strengths of market parties, fully mobilize professional market resources to resolve conflicts and disputes, and promote the establishment of dispute resolution and compensation relief mechanisms between issuers and investors. For group civil compensation disputes triggered by illegal acts such as false statements, insider trading, and market manipulation, where people's courts need to declare legal rules and unify legal application through judicial judgments, the court accepting the case may select representative cases from those with representativeness in fact-finding and legal application as model cases, try them first and render judgments in a timely manner, guide other parties to resolve disputes through the diversified resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes, and increase efforts to resolve conflicts and disputes related to the STAR Market, especially group cases.

17. Strengthen the construction of specialized financial trial institutions and enhance the professional level of the securities trial team. In light of the distribution of financial institutions and the volume of financial cases, explore the establishment of financial courts in regions where financial cases are relatively concentrated, and implement centralized jurisdiction over securities infringement cases. Other people's courts with a large number of financial cases may set up specialized collegiate panels for financial trials. Actively adapt to the new requirements imposed on the work of the people's courts by supply-side structural reform of the financial sector and financial risk prevention and control; on the basis of carefully summarizing trial experience, strengthen the analysis, study, and knowledge reserves concerning cases involving the STAR Market; conduct targeted special training on securities trials; further enrich the trial capacity of people's courts at all levels; and strive to build a securities trial team with high political quality and strong professional competence.
